preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of dominoes n must be an even integer between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in dominoes)
preconditions.description: Each domino must contain two integers a_i and b_i, both between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in set1) and all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in set2) for set1, set2 in possible_divisions)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there must exist a valid division of dominoes into two sets with distinct numbers.
